report_comment.text: TPM4 encodes tropomyosin 4. ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development. TPM4::ALK is a documented ALK fusion in inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor. The rearrangement joins an amino-terminal partner to the carboxy-terminal ALK kinase region. Crizotinib is US-approved for ALK-positive unresectable, recurrent or refractory inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor in adults and children aged at least 1 year.
